understanding.goal_understanding: Finish each level by navigating the character to the goal gem tile marked '+', avoiding any spike tiles that immediately end the attempt when landed on, within the limited attempts and turn budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a horizontal action (MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT), after which gravity automatically carries the character in the current gravity direction until they land on a solid/support tile, hit a hazard (spikes), or reach the goal. CLICK can be used on specific coordinates to remove breakable 'x' blocks to open new fall paths or change where gravity will carry you, and clicks do not count as horizontal movement for any moving-platform timers. UNDO reverts the previous action to recover from a mistake.
